description: Buy the full report for one wallet and tax year ($29 up to 500 events, $59 up to 5,000, $99 above; upgrades charge the difference). method "card" charges the account owner's saved card: needs Authorization: Bearer ptx_… and the owner's opt-in; set max_price_cents to cap it. method "usdc" returns a quote: send exactly that USDC amount on HyperEVM (chain 999) to the given address, then call again with quote_id and tx_hash. (x402 clients can instead pay in USDC on Base or Solana at GET https://papertax.xyz/api/buy?address=…&year=….) Returns an unlock_token and export links. This spends money: confirm with the user first.

max_price_cents.description: Card only: refuse if the price is higher than this
